scope: R2.4 read-only external evidence follow-up; not a new RAVM training experiment
selection_before_analysis: All released NO2 sensor systems and all released product versions, all three cities and full time range; pair only with the provider-designated ratified reference where unambiguous
reason: NO2 has a documented co-located regulatory reference and daily zero/span checks; this gives paired field measurement discrepancies rather than operational-state fault labels
metrics: Exact units, finite pair counts, reference coverage, signed error median and absolute-error median/95th percentile per sensor system/product version. No fitted calibrator, no invented fault classifier, no rate chosen to match 5/10/20 percent
no_transfer_claim: Air-quality ppb discrepancies do not calibrate utilization/temperature perturbations, injected fractions, replay prevalence or one-hour incident duration in target DT sites
missingness: Any hourly gap duration is an availability description within observed bounds, not a causal failure label; hourly aggregation cannot resolve sub-hour events
frozen_science: No Main/E0-E5 parameters, outcomes, centers, seeds, weights or source-to-lifecycle acceptance changed
